svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Which face wins
svg.desc: Face statuses from highest to lowest priority: 1. Knock greeting (two knocks on its head: WHAT'S UP?); 2. Shake (dizzy while shaken, then a flat REALLY?); 3. Night (23:00 to 07:00: heavy eyes, a dim screen); 4. On air (something records from the microphone); 5. Meeting soon (from 5 minutes before, Odoo or Google); 6. Focus timer (lying flat: it counts up, notifications off); 7. Timer done (for 15 seconds after standing it up); 8. Laptop locked (LUNCH BREAK from 12 to 14, else AWAY); 9. Claude needs you (a Claude Code session waits for me); 10. Log your hours (the day before has under 4 hours logged); 11. CI red (a recent pull request fails its checks); 12. Claude done (a Claude Code session just finished); 13. Locked in (an Odoo task is in development). Otherwise the plain face.
svg.text: Every frame, the firmware shows the first status that applies, highest first.
dizzy while shaken, then a flat
lying flat: it counts up, notifications
for 15 seconds after standing it up
a Claude Code session waits for
the day before has under 4 hours
a recent pull request fails its
an Odoo task is in development
Nothing applies: the plain face. A
